title: VPN Password Reset
content: Employees can reset their VPN password through the corporate password portal. Open the password portal, choose 'Reset Password', verify your identity using MFA, and create a new password.

title: VPN Connection Troubleshooting
content: If the VPN does not connect, verify your internet connection, restart the VPN client, and ensure MFA approval is completed. If the issue continues, contact IT support.

title: Wi-Fi Troubleshooting
content: If corporate Wi-Fi is not working, disconnect and reconnect to the network, verify your credentials, and restart the device if necessary.

title: Laptop Restart
content: For a basic laptop issue, save your work and restart the laptop. If the problem continues after restart, contact IT support.

title: MFA Setup
content: Employees should register the approved authentication application and complete the MFA enrollment process using the instructions provided by IT.
